title: Sale Credits, Delivery Reserves and Rolling Reserves on Northloop Payments
content:
**Rule.** When an order's payment is captured, the seller's Northloop Payments balance is credited the item subtotal plus shipping, tax excluded, and the same amount is reserved as a delivery reserve. The delivery reserve is released on the order's delivered date plus the plan's delivery reserve days, plus the high-value extra hold days when the sale credit is at or above the plan's high-value threshold; an order with no delivered scan is released on its promised delivery date plus the no-scan release days. On a plan with a rolling reserve rate above zero, the rate times the sale credit is additionally held as a rolling risk reserve, released the rolling reserve hold days after the sale credit date. Release dates are counted in calendar days; a reserve whose release date falls on the handling date is released that day. The plan in force on the sale credit date governs the reserve.

The rolling reserve amount is the sale credit multiplied by the rolling reserve rate, rounded to the cent.

## Plan figures read by the rule

For each payout plan the rule reads that plan's own delivery reserve days, high-value order threshold, high-value extra hold days and rolling reserve rate:

| Payout plan | Delivery reserve days | High-value threshold (USD) | High-value extra days | Rolling reserve rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payments Starter | 21 | 1000.00 | 7 | 0.1 |
| Payments Biweekly | 7 | 2500.00 | 7 | 0 |
| Payments Weekly | 7 | 2500.00 | 7 | 0 |
| Payments Daily | 7 | 5000.00 | 5 | 0 |
| Payments Daily Plus | 3 | 10000.00 | 3 | 0 |
| Payments Enterprise | 3 | 25000.00 | 0 | 0 |

## Release date, condition by condition

| Situation of the order | Delivery reserve release date |
|---|---|
| Delivered; sale credit below the plan's high-value threshold | delivered date plus the delivery reserve days |
| Delivered; sale credit at or above the plan's high-value threshold | delivered date plus the delivery reserve days plus the high-value extra hold days |
| No delivered scan | promised delivery date plus the no-scan release days |

A rolling risk reserve, where the plan's rate is above zero, is released the rolling reserve hold days after the sale credit date.

## Hypothetical worked examples

- *Payments Weekly, sale credit 3000.00 USD, delivered on day D.* 3000.00 is at or above the 2500.00 threshold, so the release date is D plus 7 plus 7, that is D plus 14 calendar days. Had the sale credit been 2400.00 USD, the release date would be D plus 7.
- *Payments Starter, sale credit 245.55 USD.* The rolling risk reserve is 245.55 multiplied by 0.1, that is 24.555, rounded to the cent: 24.56 USD, released 90 calendar days after the sale credit date.
- *Release on the handling date.* A reserve whose computed release date is today is released today.
- *Plan moved after the sale.* A sale credited while the account was on Payments Starter keeps the Payments Starter reserve terms, because the plan in force on the sale credit date governs.
